messages:
Maya (CS): quick day0 check-in for Frostline private VPC onboarding — main agenda: KMS rotation, audit log forwarding, and IP allowlist for Splunk collectors.
Olivia (Frostline): thanks — first Q: compliance requires 90d KMS rotation. Is that supported?
Ravi (SE): FYI their KMS is an account-managed key with alias arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:alias/frostline-redwood — AWS native rotation is annual. We can either: 1) implement a customer-managed rotation (Lambda rotate every 90d) or 2) use key versioning + key creation schedule.
Olivia (Frostline): option 1 sounds fine if you provide the Lambda. Any impact on inference nodes?
Ravi (SE): no downtime expected if we use GenerateDataKey/Decrypt flow; just ensure roles have kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey.
Kai (NetEng): network note — audit log forwarding (to Splunk collector) will egress from their NAT GW in us-west-2. We need their final allowlist for collector IPs. We asked for collector CIDR; they gave 10.12.34.0/28 as the target in the ticket.
Olivia (Frostline): correct — Splunk ops gave that block. Do you need the VPC ID for routing confirmation?
Kai (NetEng): yes please — VPC ID and route table IDs so we can verify NAT gateway association.
Maya (CS): putting runbook link here for the team and the customer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/priv-onboard (private). Also adding the standard IAM snippet we recommend for customer cross-account role.
Maya (CS): ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root" },
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
    }
  ]
}
```
Ana (Security): security checklist: add kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:Decrypt to the role used by inference nodes, and enable CloudTrail management events for the account. CloudTrail should deliver to an S3 bucket we can access (we'll need a bucket policy allowing redwood-svc account read).
Olivia (Frostline): we can create the bucket, what's the exact bucket policy needed?
Ana (Security): sample policy: allow Principal arn:aws:iam::REX_SERVICE_ACCOUNT:role/redwood-ingest to s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject on the prefix. I can paste exact policy in the ticket.
Ravi (SE): opening internal support ticket SUP-4551 with attachments: KMS rotation lambda template, IAM role example, and CloudTrail bucket policy.
deploy-bot: Ticket SUP-4551 created — https://support.redwood.internal/tickets/SUP-4551
Olivia (Frostline): thanks — ETA on the IP allowlist confirmation? Splunk team needs date to change firewall rules.
Kai (NetEng): I'll confirm NAT association and rule propagation once they share VPC ID — ETA EOD PST today.
Maya (CS): scheduling a 30-min handoff at 14:00 PST — invite sent to Olivia and their infra lead.
Olivia (Frostline): confirmed, I'll be there and will bring our infra lead.
Ravi (SE): I'll drop the sample Lambda for 90d rotation into SUP-4551 after lunch.
Maya (CS): great — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
